summary: Enhance your knowledge of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) stations with our training course. Enroll today for expert insights!
lede: The Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Stations course helps professionals plan, operate, maintain, and oversee fueling assets with greater confidence. It covers how stations function end to end, how to interpret technical designs, and how to connect safety, compliance, cost, uptime, and long-term asset integrity. Through practical, scenario-driven learning, participants build a shared understanding across operations, HSE, finance, and management. They learn to evaluate new or upgraded infrastructure, manage risks and procedures, plan maintenance, and make informed decisions that support safe, efficient, and commercially sound station performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who interact with CNG and LNG stations in planning, approval, operations, or oversight roles.
audience: Station operators, supervisors, and forecourt managers
Consultants and technical advisors in gas infrastructure
modules: Introduction to CNG and LNG in Modern Energy and Transport
CNG and LNG Station Types and Core Components
Safety, Codes, Standards, and Regulatory Compliance
Product Quality, Measurement, and Performance Monitoring
Commercial Models, Project Economics, and Business Cases
Sustainability, ESG, and Future Trends in Gas Fueling
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of natural gas operations and safety standards. Prior experience in energy, transport, or infrastructure sectors is beneficial but not mandatory.
